description: This file defines the ParserTransactions class, a specialized parser for transaction trace files in a tracing system. It includes methods for decoding trace data, extracting fields, and handling timestamps, and references external trace-related modules.

classes.name: ParserTransactions
classes.description: A parser class for transaction trace files, extending AbstractParser, capable of decoding trace buffers and extracting transaction data.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Returns the trace type, specifically TraceType.TRANSACTIONS.

methods.name: getMagicNumber
methods.description: Returns the magic number array identifying the trace file format.

methods.name: decodeTrace
methods.description: Decodes a buffer into trace entries and updates internal offset based on proto data.

methods.name: decodeWhatFields
methods.description: Processes decoded proto to interpret bitsets into human-readable flags.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Generates a Timestamp object based on the trace entry and timestamp type.

methods.name: processDecodedEntry
methods.description: Returns the decoded trace entry object.
